name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by watching races with her father, a mechanical engineer himself. After graduating with a degree in Aerospace Engineering from the Université libre de Bruxelles, she cut her teeth in Formula 3, working her way up through the ranks. Her pragmatic approach to problem-solving and meticulous attention to detail quickly made her a valuable asset to any team. 

Isabelle is known for her unflappable demeanor, even under immense pressure. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best work. At 23XI Racing, she aims to bring a data-driven approach to race strategy and vehicle setup, always striving for marginal gains that can make all the difference on race day. She is driven by a desire to extract peak performance from both the car and the team, and is known to be an avid student of race history to draw insights from past successes and failures.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low ponytail, with a few stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: A petite woman with sharp, intelligent eyes and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the most digital environments.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Belgian dark chocolate in the team's break room.
